key_insight: OrchRM learns a reward model for multi-agent orchestration directly from intermediate execution artifacts, enabling scalable orchestration-level training without human labels.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to improve LLM-based multi-agent system coordination with much lower token cost, making reward-guided orchestrator training and test-time scaling more efficient.
method: Build win-lose pairs from intermediate artifacts produced by multi-agent executions.
Train a Bradley-Terry reward model to score orchestration quality self-supervised.
Use the learned reward to guide orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling at the orchestration level.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 10x lower token usage during training and up to 8% higher accuracy in test-time scaling across mathematical reasoning, web QA, and multi-hop reasoning.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of intermediate artifacts and may be less reliable if those signals are noisy or sparse in new multi-agent workflows.
